Level rewards

Levels 26–30
LEVELREWARD
26One Feat From CTHULU BY TORCHLIGHT (CURATED LIST)
27ASI [Stat Cap increases +2]
28Epic Boon of Choice
29ASI [Stat Cap increases +2]
30Class Capstone [Must have 17 levels in that given class] OR Attribute Based Capstone [For Multiclasses]

Class capstones

The level-30 reward requires 17 levels in the chosen class for its class capstone, or offers an attribute-based capstone for multiclasses. The spellcaster capstone applies to druids, clerics, sorcerers, wizards, warlocks and bards.

Class capstones
ClassCapstone and effects
Spellcaster

Master of the Weave

Pick any one 10th level spell available on your classes' spell list. You may cast this once every 30 days. After the full duration of the casting, take 1d4 levels of exhaustion.

THIS IS THE CAPSTONE FEATURE FOR DRUIDS, CLERICS, SORCERERS, WIZARDS, WARLOCKS, AND BARDS

Monk

Flawless Reversal

At the height of your martial mastery, every attack against you becomes an opportunity for perfect retaliation.

As a bonus action, you can spend 5 ki points to enter a state of flawless reversal for 1 minute:

Whenever a creature makes an attack roll against you and misses, you can use your reaction to make two unarmed strikes against that creature.

If the missed attack is a ranged or spell attack, you instead launch two bolts of ki energy at the attacker. Make a ranged spell attack using your Dexterity modifier. The bolts have a range of 60 feet and deal force damage equal to your Martial Arts die + your Wisdom modifier on a hit.

Whenever you score a critical hit while this feature is active, you regain 1 ki point.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest, unless you spend 10 ki points to activate it again.

Artificer

Masterwork Infusion

At the height of your craft, you have unlocked the deepest secrets of sustaining and restoring the magic that fuels enchanted items.

Master of Arcane Renewal: If you spend 8 hours of uninterrupted work and 500 gp worth of rare materials, you can fully restore an item to its maximum number of charges, even if it normally cannot regain them, such as items that regain charges only at dawn, or items that never recharge on their own.

Artificer’s Legacy: Magic items you recharge in this way cannot be destroyed or reduced to uselessness by rolling a 1 when they are depleted of charges. You have learned to stabilize the volatile core of their enchantments. This only works on your person, and not for any allies that posses such items.

Paladin

Avatar of the Sacred Oath

At the height of your devotion, your oath exalts you beyond mortal limits. Your very presence becomes a beacon of divine will, and your bond with your sacred steed reaches mythic heights.

Smite Unbound: Your smite spells (searing smite, wrathful smite, thunderous smite, etc.) no longer require concentration. You may maintain any number of smite spells at once, and they end only when you choose to dismiss them, or when they are expended by striking a foe.

Mythic Steed: When you cast find greater steed, you may also choose from the following creatures, in addition to the normal options:

Unicorn — a radiant celestial mount whose healing and protective aura amplifies your divine power.

Felidar (A winged lion) — a majestic beast of courage and might, embodying guardianship and valor.

Young Crystal Dragon — a luminous draconic ally of radiant scales, embodying purity and truth.

Each of these steeds is considered celestial in nature, and their bond with you is permanent unless they are slain.

Fighter

Paragon of War

At the pinnacle of mortal combat, you embody the essence of war itself. No force can break your will, and every foe that falls only sharpens your blade.

Blood for Victory: When you fail a saving throw, you may choose to succeed instead. When you do so, you lose hit points equal to half of your remaining hit point total (rounded down). This damage cannot be reduced or prevented in any way.

Relentless Momentum: While in initiative, each time you reduce an enemy creature to 0 hit points, you gain a cumulative +2 bonus to weapon damage rolls until the end of that combat.

Rogue

Shadow Sovereign

You are the perfect assassin, slipping between the folds of light and darkness with absolute mastery.

Endless Veil: Attacking while invisible or hidden does not cause you to become visible or revealed. Only casting a spell or dismissing the effect ends your invisibility, and only being directly perceived ends your hidden status.

Death’s First Claim: If you roll higher initiative than a creature, your first successful Sneak Attack against that creature during this combat maximizes the damage dice for this attack. This damage cannot be resisted or mitigated in any way

Barbarian

Titan of Rage

When you give yourself fully to your rage, you become an unstoppable force of flesh, fury, and raw might.

Unbroken Flesh: While raging, you cannot be reduced below 1 hit point by any bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. Only when your rage ends can such wounds bring you down.

Primal Ascendance: Your Strength and Constitution scores each increase to 28. Your maximum for those scores also increases to 30.

Ranger

Apex Hunter

You embody the perfect predator, beyond the limits of mortal senses and skill.

Unerring Aim: Your ranged weapon attacks ignore the distinction between normal and long range. You never suffer disadvantage due to attacking at range, and your attack rolls cannot be reduced in any way.

Perfect Senses: While in one of your favored terrains, you gain tremorsense and blindsight out to 120 feet.

Hunter’s Supremacy: Creatures you can perceive within your blindsight or tremorsense range cannot benefit from being invisible or hidden against you.

Attribute-based capstones

Attribute-based capstones
ScoreStrengthDexterityConstitutionIntelligenceWisdomCharisma

You may also grapple while wielding a weapon with the heavy or two-handed properties.Perfect Evasion – Once per short rest, impose disadvantage on one attack against you as a reaction.Undying Endurance– The first time you’d drop to 0 HP each long rest, drop to 1 HP instead.Adaptive Learning – Each dawn, gain proficiency in one skill or tool until the next dawn.Spirit’s Guidance – Once per short rest, as a reaction add your Wisdom mod to a creature’s attack roll or saving throw within 30 ft.Inspiring Authority – Once per long rest, an ally within 30 ft may reroll a failed saving throw.
24Siegebreaker – Melee attacks deal double damage to objects and structures. Critical hits on strength based melee attacks cannot be negated.Preternatural Initiative – Add proficiency bonus twice to initiative rolls.Eternal Vitality – You are immune to Exhaustion and Disease.Counter-Arcanum – Advantage on checks to counter or dispel spells.Hunter’s Clarity – Advantage on Insight, Perception, and Survival checks.Unbreakable Will – You are immune to Charm, Fear, and Possession.
26Crushing Grip –You have advantage on creatures you are grappling, creatures grappled by you have disadvantage on attacks against you, and creatures you grapple cannot perform the somatic components of spellsEndless Grace – On a failed Dex save, take half damage; on a success, take none.Legend’s Resolve – Gain 1 Legendary Resistance per long rest.Mirror of Mastery – When you counter or dispel a spell, you may cast it within 1 minute (requires a slot), even if it isn’t on your class list.True Gaze – You permanently benefit from True Seeing out to 60 ft.Crown of Command – Once per long rest, issue a supreme decree. Creatures of your choice within 60 ft must save or be Charmed (ignores immunity) for 1 minute. Hostile creatures that fail instead become Stunned until the end of their next turn.

Tenth-level spells

Open a spell to read its casting requirements and full effects.

Chronoclasm [SORCERER EXCLUSIVE]

10th-level transmutation

Casting Time: 1 action

Range: Self (30-foot radius)

Components: V, S, M (an ornate clock worth 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)

Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

You rupture the flow of time, pulling yourself and chosen creatures into a faster stream of reality. Unlike time stop, you are able to interact with others.

Temporal Dominion: For the duration, you may take 3 actions for every turn, two bonus actions, and unlimited reactions,

Temporal Stasis: All creatures you do not choose are slowed to a crawl, perceiving you only as a blur. They cannot take reactions against you.,

Fragile Thread: At the end of each of your turns, roll a d20. On a 5 or lower, the chronoclasm collapses and the spell ends. This is not subject to any feature that forces rerolling the dice, advantage, or disadvantage

Aegis of Holy Asylum [Cleric, Druid, Bard]

10th-level abjuration

Casting Time: 8 Hours

Range: 1 mile radius (centered on you)

Components: V, S, M (a flawless diamond worth at least 50, ,000 gp, which is consumed)

Duration: Permanent, until dispelled

When you weave the Aegis of Eternity, a vast dome of protective wards and radiant sigils descends upon the land. The area becomes a sanctuary of enduring power, safeguarded from malign influence, corruption, and hostile magic.

Arcane Recharge. Each creature of your choice within the area can expended spell slot of 5th level or lower once per day without expending a spell slot.

Cursebreak. While under the ward, creatures are immune to curses, including those from spells like Bestow Curse or cursed magic items. Any existing curse is suspended while the creature remains within the ward.

Mind’s Aegis. Creatures of your choice within the ward are immune to charm, possession, and mind-invading spells or effects, such as Dominate, Geas, or Detect Thoughts.Attempts to target them automatically fail.

Veil of Silence. The ward blocks all divination magic of 8th level or lower attempting to perceive the area or its creatures. Scrying, Commune, and similar spells cannot penetrate the ward.

Purification of the Tainted.For every 24 consecutive hours a creature spends within the ward, one level of contamination, corruption, or similar magical taint is cleansed from them.

Pure Weave. Within the Aegis, you cannot gain new levels of contamination.

Singular Sanctuary. A caster may only have one active Aegis of Holy Asylum in existence at a time. If you cast this spell again, the previous ward immediately ends.

Overchannel Surge. If the spell is cast again within the same area before the previous ward ends, the overlapping energies collapse in a violent backlash. Each creature in the overlapping area takes 10d10 force damage, and the caster must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

Vessel of Eternity [Sorcerer, Druid, Wizard]

10th-level necromancy

Casting Time: 24 hours

Range: Touch

Components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 50,000 gp and a vial of the target soul’s essence)

Duration: Permanent

You weave a perfect vessel for a willing soul, allowing them to inhabit a new form of immense power.

Body Forging: You create a flawless living body of any creature with a CR of 25 or lower. This body is fully real, not an illusion or simulacrum, and possesses the creature’s physical statistics.

Soul Binding: A willing soul may occupy this vessel permanently, overwriting its personality and memories but gaining its physical form. If the soul ever departs, the body crumbles to dust. The vessel does overwrite any features the original soul may have had.

True Existence: This body is treated as natural — it can age, heal, reproduce, and persist even in an antimagic field.

Anchored Being: Once this ritual is completed, it cannot be undone by wish, true polymorph, or similar magic.

Apotheosis of Radiance [CLERIC EXCLUSIVE]

10th-level abjuration

Casting Time: 1 action

Range: Self (30-foot radius)

Components: V

Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

You transcend mortal form, becoming a vessel of pure divine light.

Invulnerable Form: For the duration, you are immune to all damage and conditions.

Blinding Halo: When the spell is cast, and at the start of each of your turns, every creature of your choice within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, they are blinded until the start of your next turn. On a success, they are unaffected for that turn.

Wings of Ascendance: Brilliant angelic wings burst forth from your back, granting you a 90-foot fly speed. You can hover.

Divine Authority: Your voice carries across the battlefield. Allies within 60 feet automatically succeed on saving throws against being frightened or charmed while you maintain concentration.

Sanctify the Eternal Vessel [Cleric, Warlock]

10th-level abjuration

Casting Time: 8 hours

Range: Self

Components: V, S, M (a relic or jewel worth at least 50,000 gp, which the spell consumes)

Duration: Permanent

You call upon the highest powers of divinity to purify a mortal soul and bind it in sanctity forever.

Eternal Immunity: Your body becomes permanently immune to all curses, whether magical or divine in origin. Any effect that reduces ability scores, maximum hit points, or hit point maximum. Any effect that would prevent natural healing or recovery.,

Sanctified Form: Your body is forever resistant to corruption. Their form cannot be altered against their will by polymorph, curse of lycanthropy, vampirism, or similar effects.,

Sacred Binding: This blessing cannot be dispelled, removed by wish, or undone by mortal magic. Only direct divine intervention can strip it away.

Apocalypse of the Wild [DRUID EXCLUSIVE]

10th-level conjuration

Casting Time: 1 action

Range: 1 mile radius centered on a point you can see within range (up to 1 mile)

Components: V, S

Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute (10 rounds)

You unleash the primal will of nature, commanding the earth, sky, beasts, and elements to rise up against your foes. For the duration, once per round, natural forces assault all hostile creatures of your choice within the affected area. Each round brings a different punishment.

Round 1 – Crushing Growth: Vines and roots erupt violently. Each creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage as plants constrict and crush them. Round 2 – Avalanche: Rocks and earth batter the enemy. Each creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn as rubble pins them down.

Round 3 – Truth of the Sky and Stars: The sun or moonlight pierces through the battlefield. All affected creatures are revealed — invisibility and similar conditions end immediately. Round 4 – Savage Hunt: Animals, birds, and swarms of insects strike. Each creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Round 5 – Tempestial Fury: Lightning strikes and freezing wind tear across the land. Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d6 lightning damage and 5d6 cold damage on a failure, or half on success.

Round 6 – Howling Gale: A massive wind knocks foes off their feet. Each creature must make a Constitution saving throw or be knocked prone. Round 7 – Venomous Swarm: Biting insects descend. Each creature must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d6 poison damage on a failed save, or half as much on success. Round 8 – Elemental Trial: Harsh weather weakens the body. Each creature must make a Constitution saving throw or suffer one level of exhaustion. Round 9 – Whirlwind’s Wrath: A storm funnel forms. Each creature must make a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of its next turn, and takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save (half on success).

Round 10 – Earth’s Judgment: The ground itself turns traitor. Each creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failure, the creature gains vulnerability to all damage for 1 minute. On a success, they resist nature’s wrath but tremble before it.

Pact of the Null Crown [WARLOCK EXCLUSIVE]

10th-level abjuration

Casting Time: 1 action

Range: Self

Components: V, S

Duration: 24 hours (special, see below)

You call upon your patron to sever you from entire branches of magic, crowning yourself with an aura of nullity that no spell can pierce.

School Immunity: When you cast this spell, choose two schools of magic. For the next 24 hours, you are immune to all effects of spells from those schools, whether harmful or beneficial. Spells of those schools automatically fail to affect you.,

Arcane Backlash: While the null crown is active, you cannot benefit from spells you cast of the chosen schools either; they unravel in your presence.,

Weekly Rite: Unlike other 10th-level spells, Pact of the Null Crown can only be cast once per 7 days, regardless of spell slots or features.

The ritual brands your soul with your patron’s mark. Some warlocks describe the sensation as carrying a crown of thorns woven from broken glyphs and shattered sigils.

Thief of the Gods [Warlock, Wizard, Bard]

10th-level divination

Casting Time: 1 hour

Range: Self

Components: V, S

Duration: 7 days

You pierce the veil between destinies, bending the fabric of magic to temporarily walk another path.

Borrowed Arcana: When you cast this spell, choose one class other than your own (bard, cleric, druid, paladin, ranger, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard). For the next 7 days, you gain access to the full spell list of that class, and may prepare or know spells as if you were a member of that class. You retain your own spellcasting ability modifier and spell save DC for these spells.,

Stolen Miracle: Once every 24 hours, you may cast one spell of 8th level or lower from the borrowed class without expending a spell slot. The spell is cast at its lowest level and cannot be modified by features such as metamagic, invocations, or class-specific abilities.,

Fragile Grasp: If you attempt to swap the borrowed class before the 7 days elapse, the spell fails and any prepared or known spells from that class vanish.

Echo of the Self [WIZARD EXCLUSIVE]

10th-level necromancy

Casting Time: 1 hour

Range: Touch

Components: V, S, M (a crystal phylactery worth 50,000 gp)

Duration: Permanent (until shared health is depleted)

You weave a fragment of your own soul into a perfect copy, creating a vessel that mirrors your abilities and mind.

Soul Copy: You create a duplicate of yourself that occupies a willing clone, homunculus, or other prepared vessel. The copy has all of your statistics, proficiencies, and known spells, but shares your current and maximum hit points. Any damage dealt to either you or the copy is deducted from the shared pool of hit points.,

Independent Action: The copy can act independently, taking its own turns and using spells, abilities, or attacks as you would. It obeys your mental commands perfectly, but cannot act in ways that would reduce the shared health below 0.,

Linked Existence: If either the copy or your original body drops to 0 hit points, the other is immediately reduced to 0 hit points as well. Similarly, if the vessel is destroyed, your body is destroyed immediately. If you attempt to make another echo of self, the existing one turns to dust.

Dominion of the Voice [Bard Exclusive]

10th-level enchantment

Casting Time: 1 action

Range: 120 feet

Components: V

Duration: Instantaneous

You channel the ultimate power of your voice, bending the will of a single creature to your command. The target does not need to be able to hear you by physical means.

Absolute Command: Choose one creature within range. For one turn, you control its movements and actions as if it were willing. The target follows your direction to the best of its ability.,

Irresistible Will: This effect cannot be countered, dispelled, or altered by any means, including legendary resistances, counterspell, or magical immunity.,

Purging Command: If the caster chooses, this command immediately breaks any conditions affecting the target, including paralysis, charm, fear, or invisibility.,

Rules wording follows the level 26–30 source sheet. Source ambiguities and typographical errors are retained rather than silently changing a rule.
